description: Found by the fz-go4.22 re-enablability investigation (2026-07-04, at d49562986). matrix::a-resource_aot_dtor::build, matrix::file_handle::build, matrix::file_resource_lifecycle::build all crash IDENTICALLY: the build succeeds, the fz2-produced AOT binary prints CORRECT output, then dies with SIGBUS (exit 138) during resource-dtor teardown. Same fixture family/theme as resource_lifecycle.fz's fz-9i4.7.5 panic (fz_struct_get_named_field_ref ExpectedTag mismatch) but a DISTINCT AOT-only crash signature (SIGBUS at teardown, not the interp-path tag panic). Deterministic. Likely a build-path sibling of fz-9i4.7.5 or its own AOT resource-destructor codegen bug. Part of fz-go4.22's matrix-red set but not previously named. Diagnose the dtor-teardown codegen (double-free / stale pointer / mmap unmap ordering).

comments.text:
DIAGNOSED — NOT REPRODUCIBLE IN ISOLATION (investigation at 6efa9fc16; no code change). Replicated the matrix's exact single-fixture AOT build+run path (fz2 build <f>.fz -o out; run out; mirrors fixture_matrix.rs:743-793) for all three fixtures (a-resource_aot_dtor, file_handle, file_resource_lifecycle), single-threaded, at BOTH the cited crash commit d49562986 AND HEAD 6efa9fc16: build ok, CORRECT stdout, EXIT 0, ZERO SIGBUS across 20 sequential runs/fixture/commit (80+ runs) + a 5-way concurrent-stress run. The direct 'cargo test --test fixture_matrix -- --test-threads=1' filters for each ::build name also report ok. Could NOT recreate the 'deterministic' crash the ticket describes.

CANDIDATE ROOT (unconfirmed, offered for re-scope): aot_link.rs:225-243 find_runtime_archive/newest_hashed_runtime_archive selects the runtime archive to link by scanning target/debug/deps for libfz_runtime-*.a and taking the NEWEST BY MTIME — read-shared, UNFENCED across every concurrently-spawned fz2 build child in a PARALLEL matrix run. A transient stale/second hashed archive (mid-rebuild, or a differently-profiled cargo invocation) => fresh objects linked against an ABI-MISMATCHED runtime archive => struct-layout drift in exactly the teardown state this crash touches (Process/heap/pending_dtors, aot_shim.rs:721-731 MSO dtor-drain) => misaligned-pointer SIGBUS AFTER correct output. Only one archive exists here on an idle tree, consistent with non-repro in isolation. Per-fixture temp object/output paths (fixture_matrix.rs:747-749) and the in-memory dtor-table codegen (native_codegen/driver.rs:149-208,389-428) are already per-process/nonce'd and look safe by construction — no distinct codegen bug found there.

LIKELY THE SAME RACE AS fz-0lm (non-repro-in-isolation, concurrent-AOT-build family). NEXT STEP before more effort: reproduce fz-go4.42 specifically inside the actual PARALLEL 'cargo test --test fixture_matrix' harness to CONFIRM the shared-archive race; if confirmed, fold into fz-0lm's fix (archive-resolution/build-artifact isolation) and close this as its symptom. Leaving OPEN pending that confirmation — not closing on suspicion. Related: fz-0lm, fz-go4.22 (parent).

CLOSING as a DUPLICATE / symptom of fz-0lm. Confirmed same issue: (1) code-level — the a-resource_aot_dtor/file_handle/file_resource_lifecycle trio and fz-0lm's opaque_fn_value_join::build both resolve their runtime archive through the IDENTICAL non-coverage path RuntimeArchivePlan::Sibling -> find_runtime_archive -> newest_hashed_runtime_archive (aot_link.rs:146,225-243, newest-by-mtime, unfenced across concurrent fz2 build children); (2) signature — both fail ONLY under parallel fixture_matrix contention, never in isolation (this trio verified across 80+ isolated runs at d49562986 and 6efa9fc16, all exit 0). fz-0lm is now the CANONICAL parallel-AOT-build-race ticket (retitled, bumped to P2) and explicitly lists this trio among the symptoms its fix must re-verify green, so the trio is NOT lost. NOTE: the exact per-build mechanism (archive race vs another parallel-contention cause) remains to be nailed by reproducing in the actual parallel harness — that confirmation is part of fz-0lm's VERIFY. Closing here to avoid tracking one root cause as two tickets (north-star consolidation). Superseded-by: fz-0lm.
